column1: # Lane ui2 (React component tests of app/test/unit/ui): cases that only check React DOM structure, CSS classes, ARIA, focus, event wiring or children rendered unchanged.

# Corvene's counterparts are GPUI elements and views, which integration tests cannot render or drive (no gpui test-support). Cases about content a component itself shows are ported with stand-ins instead.

column2: layout and message components › renders row and errors wrappers with expected semantics
column3: n/a: React DOM wrappers (#id and .row-component / .spaced-row classes on Row, role=alert and .errors-component on Errors); Corvene lays rows out as GPUI flex divs and shows errors with widgets::input_error / dialog_error_banner, GPUI elements with no classes or roles to query

column2: layout and message components › renders warning variants with the expected icon styling and suppresses context menus
column3: n/a: React DOM checks: .warning-icon / .information-icon / .error-icon classes per CommitWarningIcon and a contextmenu event whose default is prevented; Corvene's CommitWarning (ChangesSidebar::commit_warning in changes.rs) takes the octicon and colour from each caller (no icon kind to map) and GPUI has no browser context menu to suppress

column2: PasswordTextBox › toggles password visibility, keeps focus on the input, and forwards value changes
column3: n/a: React DOM checks (input type password/text, aria-pressed on the toggle, document.activeElement after clicking it, onValueChanged from a change event); Corvene's password fields are gpui-kit InputState(.masked(true)) in sign_in.rs and ssh_key_passphrase.rs with no visibility toggle, and GenericGitAuthDialog's password field (remote_dialogs.rs) is not masked at all (GHD generic-git-auth.tsx uses PasswordTextBox)

column2: path text and link button surfaces › does not exceed React update depth while looking for a fitting truncation
column3: n/a: guards against React's maximum update depth while PathText re-measures spans with getBoundingClientRect; Corvene's PathText (corvene_ui::path_text) finds the longest fitting truncation with a binary search inside one prepaint, no render loop or state updates

column2: path text and link button surfaces › treats uri links as links and callback-only links as buttons
column3: n/a: React DOM roles and event wiring of LinkButton (href and role=link for uri, role=button for onClick, shell.openExternal on click, onMouseOver, disabled); Corvene's widgets::link_button is a GPUI element whose callers attach on_click (Dispatcher::open_url or a callback), with no href or role to query

column2: SectionList scrolling › never makes per-section grids independently scrollable
column3: n/a: react-virtualized SectionList's per-section Grid elements must not get overflow-y: auto (desktop/desktop#22387); Corvene's repository list draws all groups in one GPUI scroll container, there are no nested section grids

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › starts line selection on primary-button mousedown events
column3: n/a: React mousedown wiring of SideBySideDiffRow's line gutter to onStartSelection(row, column, select); Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view (a MouseButton::Left handler starts a TempSelection with selected = !stored_selected), with nothing callable to drive

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › starts line deselection when the line is already selected
column3: n/a: React mousedown wiring of SideBySideDiffRow's line gutter to onStartSelection(..., select: false) for a selected line; Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view (the left-button handler passes selected = !stored_selected), with nothing callable to drive

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › ignores non-primary mousedown events on line gutters
column3: n/a: React mousedown wiring (button 1 and 2 on a line gutter start nothing); Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view: the gutter's selection handler is registered for MouseButton::Left only (Right opens the line menu)

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › infers the modified row column from the clicked line gutter
column3: n/a: React mousedown wiring inferring DiffColumn.Before / After from the clicked gutter of a modified split row; Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view (each column's split_line_number registers its own handler)

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › dispatches line number checkbox changes with row and column
column3: n/a: React click wiring of the line number checkbox (aria-label "Line 10 added") to onLineNumberCheckedChanged(row, column, select); Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view, with nothing callable to drive

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › dispatches context menus from line number labels with diff line numbers
column3: n/a: React contextmenu wiring of the line number label to onContextMenuLine(diffLineNumber); Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view (a MouseButton::Right handler opens the line menu)

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › dispatches hunk checkbox changes with the hunk start line
column3: n/a: React click wiring of the hunk checkbox ("Lines 10 to 11 added") to onClickHunk(hunkStartLine, select); Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view (the hunk handle's on_click calls Dispatcher::set_diff_lines with select = kind != All)

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › dispatches hunk checkbox changes as deselection when the row is selected
column3: n/a: React click wiring of the hunk checkbox to onClickHunk(hunkStartLine, false) for a fully selected group; Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view (the hunk handle's on_click passes select = kind != DiffSelectionType::All)

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › dispatches context menus from hunk handles with the hunk start line
column3: n/a: React contextmenu wiring of the hunk handle to onContextMenuHunk(hunkStartLine); Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view (a MouseButton::Right handler opens hunk_menu)

column2: SideBySideDiffRow › dispatches hunk expansion clicks with the expansion type
column3: n/a: React click wiring of the Expand Up button to onExpandHunk(hunkIndex, expansionType); Corvene's split and unified diff rows (diff_view_rows.rs render_row / render_split_row / split_line_number) wire GPUI handlers inline in the view (expansion_handle's on_click calls DiffView::expand with the direction)

column2: static status and link components › renders action status icons for each computed state and hides null status
column3: n/a: React DOM checks (.merge-icon-container per non-null status, .merge-loading / -clean / -conflicts / -invalid classes); Corvene has no ActionStatusIcon component, the merge dialog's status header (dialogs/branch_dialogs.rs) picks DotFill / X / Check / Alert inline as getSymbolForState does, with no classes to query

column2: static status and link components › renders segmented item titles and optional descriptions
column3:
n/a: React DOM checks (.title and

elements of SegmentedItem); Corvene's widgets::segmented_option renders the title and optional description as a GPUI element

column2: structural and text components › renders form, dialog content, and ui view wrappers and prevents default submit behavior
column3: n/a: React DOM wrappers (#id.ui-view, form.form-component and its submit event's preventDefault, .dialog-content with onRef); Corvene's views and dialogs (dialog::dialog_with_frame) are GPUI elements with no form submission or element refs

column2: TabBarItem › renders tab accessibility attributes based on selected state
column3: n/a: React DOM checks (role=tab, aria-selected, tabindex, the button ref callback); Corvene's tab bars (tab_bar::tab_bar / vertical_tab_bar) are GPUI rows whose tabs call on_select(index) on click, with no ARIA attributes or element refs

column2: TabBarItem › clicks, hovers, and leaves with the configured item index
column3: n/a: React event wiring of TabBarItem (onClick / onMouseEnter with the index, onMouseLeave, aria-selected and tabindex=-1 when unselected); Corvene's tab bars (tab_bar::tab_bar / vertical_tab_bar) are GPUI rows whose tabs call on_select(index) on click and have no hover callbacks

column2: TabBar › renders a tablist and marks the selected tab
column3: n/a: React DOM checks (role=tablist with .tab-bar, aria-selected per tab, two .tab-bar-separator elements in a Switch bar); Corvene's tab bars (tab_bar::tab_bar / vertical_tab_bar) are GPUI rows whose tabs call on_select(index) on click (a right border between tabs), with no ARIA attributes or classes

column2: TabBar › switches tabs after hovering during a drag operation
column3: n/a: React mouseenter wiring with dragAndDropManager and a 500 ms timer (allowDragOverSwitching, used by the branch foldout's Branches / Pull Requests tabs); Corvene's tab bars (tab_bar::tab_bar / vertical_tab_bar) are GPUI rows whose tabs call on_select(index) on click and do not switch while a commit is dragged over them (BranchFoldout::tab_bar)

column2: TextBox › renders textbox labels, prefixed icons, and forwards focus or blur, key, change, and enter callbacks
column3: n/a: React DOM and event wiring of TextBox (label, aria-describedby, .prefixed-icon, onFocus / onValueChanged / onKeyDown / onEnterPressed / onBlur from DOM events); Corvene's text boxes are gpui-kit InputState inside widgets::text_box / filter_text_box (prefix icon, InputEvent subscriptions per view), with nothing to dispatch DOM events to

column2: TextBox › clears search text through the clear button and announces that the input was cleared
column3: n/a: React DOM checks of TextBox (the input value, document.activeElement after the click, onValueChanged('') and onSearchCleared, the live text); Corvene's filter_text_box (widgets.rs) clears the kit InputState and announces "Input cleared" in a Role::Status live child until a value is typed again, with no DOM to query

column2: TextBox › clears or blurs search inputs when escape is pressed
column3: n/a: React keydown and focus wiring of a search TextBox (Escape clears a value, then blurs to document.body with onBlur); Corvene's text boxes are gpui-kit InputState inside widgets::text_box / filter_text_box, Escape is handled by each view (foldouts close)

column2: visual helper surfaces › renders octicons and creates octicon wrapper elements
column3: n/a: React DOM checks (svg.octicon with a class and aria-hidden, createOcticonElement's wrapper element with id and class); Corvene's icons::octicon returns a GPUI svg element and there are no DOM wrapper elements

column2: visual helper surfaces › renders donut segments for non-zero values and preserves the aria label
column3: n/a: React DOM checks of Donut (svg.donut aria-label, one <path> per non-zero value-map key with the key as class); Corvene's ci_check_popover::donut counts RefChecks by colour and paints arcs on a GPUI canvas, with no value map, classes or aria label

column2: welcome and sign-in wrappers › submits enterprise endpoints through the shared sign-in wrapper
column3: n/a: React event wiring of SignIn's endpoint entry (the address typed into the 'Enterprise address' field forwarded unchanged to dispatcher.setSignInEndpoint by Continue, the children buttons rendered as given); Corvene's sign-in dialog (dialogs/sign_in.rs SignInDialog) forwards the typed address unchanged to Dispatcher::set_sign_in_endpoint from its private continue_endpoint inside the GPUI view (sign_in_content only names the Continue action, SignInAction::SetEndpoint), with no event to fire outside a window
